title: Statutes (Miscellaneous Amendments) Act 2008 (Commencement) Notification 2024
header_as_printed: 1 S 244/2024 / First published in the Government Gazette, Electronic Edition, on 28 March 2024 at 5 pm. / No. S 244 / STATUTES (MISCELLANEOUS AMENDMENTS) ACT 2008 / STATUTES (MISCELLANEOUS AMENDMENTS) ACT 2008 / (COMMENCEMENT) NOTIFICATION 2024
source_provider: Republic of Singapore Government Gazette, e-Gazette (www.egazette.gov.sg); the PDF is served as a static file from assets.egazette.gov.sg
first_published_line: First published in the Government Gazette, Electronic Edition, on 28 March 2024 at 5 pm
commencement: The Statutes (Miscellaneous Amendments) Act 2008, except sections 9 and 12, comes into operation on 1 April 2024
obtained_how: One GET request with curl, User-Agent "legalese-commons-source-fetcher/1.0 (+https://github.com/legalese/commons)", at least 5 seconds after the previous request, into a new download directory outside the repository, at a URL that the orchestrating session had read off a result in the e-Gazette index and passed to the encoder. The assets host serves the PDF with 200. The text file is the output of "pdftotext -layout" (poppler) on the PDF, unedited: the PDF has a text layer, so there was no OCR. Page breaks are form-feed characters. The converter may mis-order or drop characters, so the text is an aid for quotation and the PDF is the source.
terms: e-Gazette Terms of Use, https://www.egazette.gov.sg/terms-of-use/ (page says "Last updated on 10 July 2026"), clause 11 "Reproduction of legislation-Gazettes"; read on 2026-11-03; the wording is quoted in ../broadcasting-act-1994/registers/source-bundle/SOURCE-LICENSE-GAZETTE.md.
evidence_status: The e-Gazette FAQ (https://www.egazette.gov.sg/faq/, read 2026-11-03) says: "Before 9 March 2025, only copies of the Gazette printed by the Government Printer are regarded as prima facie evidence of their contents." This item was published before that date, so this copy is an aid and is not stated to be prima facie evidence.
